title: Morning at the window
text: The rain drew thin lines across the window.

title: A quiet morning
text: I made a pot of tea and opened my notebook.

title: The last lamp
text: A single lamp kept the small street awake.

title: An old letter
text: I found a letter I had forgotten in the drawer.

title: The night train
text: The night train carried the smell of rain and coffee.

title: Counting stars
text: We counted stars until the city lights faded behind us.
